headline: Recep Baştuğ: "We aim to bring sustainable financing exceeding 3 billion dollars into our portfolio"
summary: DenizBank issued a five-year green bond worth $100 million as part of its first cooperation with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Its general manager targets over $3 billion of sustainable financing by year-end.
why: DenizBank is a Turkish lender, and green bonds and multilateral funding give banks access to long-term foreign capital for sustainable lending.
